title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focused learning at Bryan College of Health Sciences, from quiet library zones to collaborative simulation debriefing rooms.

cards.title: The Quiet Side of the Library
cards.subtitle: Bryan College of Health Sciences Library
cards.notes: Designated for individual, intentional study. Maintain silence to respect others engaged in deep focus within this primary campus resource.
cards.short_summary: A strictly quiet zone for individual study located within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The “Quiet Side” of the Library is designated for individual, quiet, intentional study.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 am to 4:30 pm during summer; check regular semester hours for late-night availability.

cards.title: Library Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet Side, BCOHS Library
cards.notes: Reserve this space online for collaborative sessions. Monitor sound levels to avoid disrupting the adjacent quiet study areas.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room for group collaboration located on the quiet side of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Group Study Room (on the “Quiet Side”) may be reserved for group use.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Requires online reservation through the library's booking tool.

cards.title: Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: BCOHS Library
cards.notes: Features casual seating for group work and socializing. Use the college computers for research or collaborative digital projects.
cards.short_summary: A social study space with computer access and casual seating for group interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Lab is a space for individual and group use of the College computers, and has casual seating for group work.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Available during standard library operating hours.

cards.title: Testing Center Study Space
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Instructional Location
cards.notes: Utilize this space for small group study when it is not being used for accommodated or makeup exams.
cards.short_summary: A quiet area available for small group study during non-testing hours.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for testing, the space is available to students for small group study.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Availability is subject to the testing schedule; check with the Testing Center Coordinator.

cards.title: West Campus Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bryan Medical Center West
cards.notes: A dedicated area for students at the West site, convenient for those attending Natural Science laboratories or cadaver labs.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge located at the West Campus instructional site.
cards.evidence_claim: This location is home to... a student lounge area.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located at the West site, 2300 S. 16th St.

cards.title: Simulation Debriefing Rooms
cards.subtitle: Simulation Center
cards.notes: Four specialized rooms designed for reviewing clinical simulations, ideal for focused group analysis and healthcare-specific study.
cards.short_summary: Specialized rooms within the Simulation Center used for debriefing and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The space offers eight simulation rooms, four control rooms, and four debriefing rooms.
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Access typically coordinated through clinical faculty or simulation staff.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Access academic support services and find a supportive environment for learning and peer interaction.
cards.short_summary: A hub for academic resources and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Take advantage of our Student Success Center; Enjoy the many student services we provide.
cards.source_title: Student Life - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open during regular business hours for student support and study.

cards.title: The Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: A focused space for improving academic writing. Work with tutors or use the area for quiet drafting and revision.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for students to receive writing assistance and work on assignments.
cards.evidence_claim: Quick Links: Bryan College of Health Sciences Homepage Student Services Writing Center.
cards.source_title: Bryan College of Health Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Appointments may be required for tutoring; check current schedule.

cards.title: East Campus Student Lounges
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Building
cards.notes: Check out what current students are up to in these social hubs. Ideal for casual study and connecting with peers between classes.
cards.short_summary: Informal lounge areas located throughout the main Lincoln campus building.
cards.evidence_claim: ...check out what current students are up to in our student lounges.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: Campus Conference Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Instructional Location
cards.notes: Professional spaces available for student use when not reserved for official college meetings or faculty sessions.
cards.short_summary: Formal meeting rooms that can serve as quiet group study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus educational setting includes classrooms, conference rooms, a Simulation Center...
cards.source_title: Campus Facilities | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Check availability and reservation requirements at the main office.
